newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexicano, Santander reach link-up accord - paper.
newsitem.headline: Mexicano, Santander reach link-up accord - paper.

text.p: Mexico's Banco Mexicano SA and the Mexican unit of Spain's Banco Santander SA have reached an agreement in principle to link up and form an association in which the Spanish group will have majority control, Reforma newspaper said Monday.

Citing no sources in a business news column, Reforma said Mexicano and Grupo Santander, as the Mexican unit is called, are currently in talks with the National Banking Commission which would have to approve such a merger. The daily said the announcement could be made as early as this week.
Only last week, a Grupo Santander official told a Mexico City investment forum that the unit was interested in acquiring a Mexican bank to increase its role in the national credit market.
